chunks: Al-‘Alā’ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
If a man marries a young slave-girl who is still nursing, and his wife breastfeeds her, the marriage becomes invalid.

key_terms.فَسَدَ: became invalid or corrupted in legal effect

ai.seo_question: How does breastfeeding affect the validity of a marriage in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning rada'ah (breastfeeding) and its effect on marriage validity. It states that if a man's wife breastfeeds the young girl he married, the marriage is invalidated due to the legal consequences of foster-relations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4670 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: "
If a man marries a young girl (jariyah) who is still nursing, and his wife then breastfeeds her, the marriage becomes invalid."
